tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

dpal dregs pa dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo: rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs: bsam yas brtsigs pa'i dus su lha srin sde brgyad kha langs 'dug pa la: gu rus dregs pa kha bcing ba: sde brgyad zil gyis gnon pa'i sgrub pa mdzad do: de la gsum ste: rdzas dang: sngags dang: ting nge 'dzin no: dang po rdzas kyi rim pa la: srid pa'i bya khyung gi sgo nga dang: zangs kyi ga'u la zer/ gnam chag pa'i dum bu dang: g.yu mig med la zer/ sa ral ba'i ras ma dang: gser sa g.yung ma la zer/ 'brong kham pa'i rnga ma dang: za 'og gi skud pa la zer/ steng 'og bar gsum lha 'dre rnams: zil gnon dbang sdud bla rdo yin: lha bskyed dgug gzhug byas te/ sgo nga'i nang du bla rdo gzhug: bla rdo'i 'khor lo bri ba ni: chu dar dkar po khru gang la: dpang mtho gang*/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bri bar bya: sngags ni rtsibs brgyad dag la bri: rtsibs brgyad dag la sde brgyad ming: dbus su hrīḥgacig bri bar bya: mu khyud dbang chen sngags kyis bskor: bri ba'i rgyu ni khrag sna gsum: gri khrag mngal khrag dge slong srin lag khrag / 'bri snyug zangs kyi smyu gu yis: stag lo pas bzos pa/ bris la 'khor lo'i nang du bla rdo dril: za 'og skud pas dam du bcing: rgya gram dkris la rgya yis btab: sgo nga rkang pa'i 'og tu gzhug: de ni rdzas kyi bca' thabs so: de nas dbang chen sngags 'di bzla: hrīḥm hā kro ta pad+mān+ta kṛta ha yaṃ grī wa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ya ma ra tsa du tri phu ti hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa: hrīḥnas phaṭa bar bcu drug pa: pad+ma dbang chen snying po yin: khams gsum dbang du sdud par byed: ya nas ti bar yig 'bru brgyad: gshin rje ma mo rgyal po btsan: bdud dang the'u 'gong klu dang gza': sde brgyad dbang du sdud pa'i sngags: hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa te yi ge gsum: srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i sngags:

gnam sa bar gsum lha 'dre kun: thams cad kha chings zil gyis gnon: gdug pa kha bcing zhes su grags: kha chings zil gnon ting 'dzin ni: bdag nyid tha mal snying kha na: yi ge hrīḥdamar gnas pa las: bdag nyid hrīḥyi lus su gyur: hrīḥde 'od du zhu ba las: bdag nyid dbang chen rgyal po ni: dbu ni tshangs pa'i yul rtser bslebs: zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i gting du brkyangs: g.yas kyi phyag gis gzugs khams 'degs: g.yon gyis 'dod khams sa gzhi gnon: nyi zla gza' skar rked la 'khor: sku mdog bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar: sku stegs ri rab steng na 'cha': dbu gtsug rta mgo rta skad 'tsher: g.yas kyi rta skad thengs gsum gyis: srid pa pho rgyud dbang du sdud: g.yon gyi rta skad thengs gsum gyis: srid pa mo rgyud dbang du sdud: steng gi rta skad thengs gsum gyis: srid pa'i gza' rnams dbang du sdud: 'og gi rta skad thengs gsum gyis: srid pa'i klu rnams dbang du sdud: hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa gsum bsgrags pa yis: 'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba tsam: khams gsum dbang du sdud byed cing: srid gsum zil gyis gnon par bsgom: de yi thugs ka'i hrīḥ'aphros pas: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kun: bu ga dgu ru phog pa yis: hrīḥyis sgo dgu bkag nas ni: gdug pa thams cad kha bcings bsam: dbang chen zil gnon sngags bzlas pas: lha 'dre thams cad 'khrugs gyur te: dang po cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston: bar du dbang 'dus bka' la nyan: tha ma ci bsgos las rnams byed: bu ga bsal la las la btang: dregs pa dbang sdud zil gnon 'di: klu chen brgyad dang klu phran dang: lha chen brgyad dang lha phran dang: ma mo ye shes mkha' 'gro dang: grong rgyu bsen mo yan chad dang: gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po nas: 'chi bdag las 'dre thams cad dang: rgyal po gnam lha man chad nas: srid rkun the'u rang yan chad dang: bdud rje 'gong yag man chad nas:

nag po s+t+wa thogs yan chad dang: btsan rgod yam shud dmar po nas: shar ba phreng thogs yan chad dang: srid pa'i lha rabs sham po nas: yul lha lha phran thams cad dang: bgegs rgyal bi nā ya ka nas: yul 'dre chags 'dre yan chad dang: gza' bdud rog ti man chad nas: gza' phran rkun po yan chad rnams: dang po kha 'ching zil gyis gnon: bar du dbang 'dus bka' la nyan: tha ma las rnams ci bcol byed: pad+ma thod phreng rgyal po ngas: rje yi bka' byung bod du mchis: srid pa'i lha 'dre gdug rtsub che: bod kyi lha 'dre 'dul bar dka': lha srin sde brgyad bsgo ma nyan: tshe la dbang thob rig 'dzin pa: dbang chen 'dus pa'i rgyud las ni: dregs pa kha chings zil gnon rnyed: snang srid lha 'dre zil gyis mnan: rje yi thugs dam bsam yas bzhengs: rgyal po'i thugs dgongs 'grub par bgyis: spel ba'i gnas med gter du sbas: las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: bar gyi gnod sbyin 'dul ba la: 'di las lhag pa med do bu: ྈྈྈ rgyaṃrgyaṃrgyaṃ: ༈ dbang chen dbang sdud rgyal po la bstod pa ni: hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa: hrī: dbang chen las la mnga' mdzad khro bo'i rje: sku mdog dmar nag thams cad dbang du sdud: dbu ni nam mkha'i khams su rta skad 'tsher: zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i gting du klu rnams gnon: g.yas kyi phyag gis snang srid gzugs khams 'degs: g.yon gyi phyag gis 'dod khams sa gzhi gnon: nyi zla gza' skar rked bcings gza' rnams 'dul: dur khrod chas brgyad lha srin sde brgyad 'jigs: rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud: hrīḥyi sgra chen srid gsum 'gul zhing sngangs: phaṭa kyis thog 'beb bdud dpung spyi nas 'joms: hūm̐ gi nga ros gdug pa bran du 'khol: phyag mtshan mtshon chas ri rab rdul du 'jig: bskal pa'i me 'bar 'jig rten ma lus sreg: 'jig rten dregs pas khengs pa'i sde brgyad ni: dregs pa gza' dang sde brgyad klu la sogs:

'chi bdag gshin rje nad gtong ma mo dang: che btsan rgyal po rol pa btsan gyi tshogs: nag po bdud dang the'u rang bgegs kyi tshogs: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang po che: rang dbang med par dbang sdud zil gyis gnon: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs dang gzi brjid 'phrog: rang byung thugs rje'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥm hā kro ta pad+mān+ta kṛta ha ya grī wa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ya ma ra tsa du tri phu ti hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa: ces bzlas so: dregs pa dbang sdud kyi bstod pa rdzogs so: ྈྈ ྈྈྈ ༈ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: rang nyid dpal chen rta mgrin sku: shin tu gsal ba'i bsnyen pa sngon du song ba/ ngang nyid du: sde brgyad gnad la rang gshed rang la dbab pa/ 'bebs 'dod pa'i: rnal 'byor pas ni 'di ltar bya: rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste: spyi ru dril dang so sor dbye: spyir dril gzhan du shes par bya: so sor dbye bar 'dod pa yis: 'khor lo brgyad du bri bar bya: dkyil du sde brgyad rang rang srog snying la: rtsibs la rtsa ba'i sngags rnams bri: tha ma me ri 'bar bas bskor: 'khor lo legs par tshar ba dang: zangs kyi ga 'u'i nang du bcug: skud pa sngon dmar dag gis dkri: bdag nyid dbang chen thugs ka nas: hrīḥlas 'od zer dmar nag 'phros: gang 'dod snying gi mtshams nas bkug: 'khor lo dag la bstim par bya: skabs su gu gul dud pas bdug: sngags 'di sngon du bzlas par bya: hrīḥm hā kro ta pad+mān+ta kṛta ha yaṃ grī wa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ya gshin rje che ge mo'i srog dbang du sdus shig: gsang sngags yi ge bcu drug pa: mi tshig gis bar ma chod pa/ khri phrag gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur: sde brgyad kun la de ltar bsdu: de yi rtags rnams byung ba dang: 'khor lo spos dkar chu nas bton: 'khor lo me long la bstan nas spos dkar btab pa'i chus khrus bya/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bcing:

seng ldeng phur pa thugs kyi rten: spyi dril 'khor lo gsung gi rten: srung ba'i 'khor lo sku yi rten: ma bral bar ni lus la bcing: pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs dam 'di: mnga' bdag rgyal po bdag la gnang: spel ba'i gnas med gter du sbos: ྈྈ ྈྈ dbang chen zil gnon sngags bzlas pas: lha 'dre thams cad 'khrugs gyur te: dang po cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston: bar du dbang sdud bka' la nyan: tha ma ci bcol las rnams byed: bu ga bsal la las la gtang: dgra la rbad na nṛ la brdeg: dam 'gong 'dul na zhum tri gdag: pu tra rak+ṣas sri 'u gso: ā yu sid+dhis tshe srog 'gugs: pi pi yer gyis phyag rgya 'gugs: nā nā kha dhes zas nor spel: 'di dag man ngag dam pa yin: drod tshad zhal gdams la sogs pa: man ngag rtsa ba'i them byang yin: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ dbang chen zil gnon sngags bzlas pas: lha 'dre thams cad 'khrugs gyur te: zhes pa ni: hrīḥm hā kro dha pad+mān+ta kṛta ha yaṃ grī wa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: gshin rje'i srog la ya: ma mo'i ma: rgyal po'i ra: btsan gyi tsa: bdud kyi du: 'gong po'i tri: klu'i phu: gza'i ti: sde brgyad zil gyis gnon pa'i sngags: hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa: dang po cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston: zhes pa ni: mon pa dang bud med: btsun pa: bu chung: rta pa: ri dwags dang: mi nag dang: spre'u dang: glang g.yag dang: me 'bar ba dang: ser ba 'beb pa dang: chu chen po 'khrugs pa la sogs pa 'ong ste: cho 'phrul ci tsam che zhing myur na dga' 'o: 'grub pa'i rtags yin no: 'jigs pa dang: zhum pa dang: khengs pa sogs mi bya bar rang lugs su bzhag go: bar du dbang sdud bka' la nyan: ces pa ni: bdag la phyag 'tshal ba dang: bskor ba byed pa dang: ci bgyi zer zhing bran dang g.yog byed na bka' nyan pa'i rtags so: tha ma ci bcol las rnams byed: ces pa ni: nyi zla shar ba dang: mtshon cha skyes pa dang: mtshon cha khong du mid pa rmis pa na: ci bcol ba'i las byed pa'i rtags so:

: bu ga bsal la las la btang: zhes pa ni: mtshan ma gtan la phebs pa gces: rdugs na dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags byung na sde brgyad gzir ba'i las mi byed/ mkha' 'gro ldog: shin tu drag na snying re rje: sems bskyed nyams 'gro bas nyams dang rmi lam du gdon shin tu rid cing bka' nyan pa byung na: gtor ma byin la las byed bsgos te las la btang: dmigs pas hrīḥkun tshur la bsdus: slar yang tshur la rgol zhing mi nyan na: gong bzhin sngags dang dmigs pas gzir: rang nyid nyams dang sbyar ba gces so: zhal gdams : las tshogs drug la: dgra la rbad na nṛ la brdeg: ces pa ni: sngags rnams rdzogs pa'i sham bu ru: dgra bo che ge mo nṛ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: ces drag tu bzla zhing sngags te liṅga dgra yul la/ thun brdeg go: dam 'gong 'dul na zhum tri gdags: zhes pa ni: dam 'gong dang rgyal 'gong 'dul na: sngags kyi sham bur: zhum tri hur thuṃ dzaḥtri mā ra ya rbad nan: zhes bzlas so: des chog go: pu tra rak+ṣas sri'u gso: zhes pa ni: sngags kyi sham bu ru: pu tra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā: zhes brgya rtsa re nang nub la bzlas pas chog: ā yu sid+dhis tshe srog 'gugs: zhes pa ni: tshe lung bzhin bcas te sngags kyi sham bu ru: ā yu sid+dhi hūm̐ ā: zhes bzlas te lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas nas lan stong gis nges par khug go: tshe rten srang la gzhal bas rtags nges par 'ong ngo: pi pi yer gyis phyag rgya 'gugs: phyag rgya bu mo mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'gugs na: rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa rdzogs nas bud med kyi rkang rjes sa dang: chu shul la mo rang gi gzugs byas te: zhag bdun smra bcad byas la yungs dkar gyis brab bo: 'grub rtags su lce rtse g.ya' ru 'ong: pi pi: yer yer: lheng lheng: theg theg: phug phug: snyil snyil: slong slong: thod de gin dhi log: yig 'bru bcu dgu gi gu drug: 'greng bu bdun:

na ro bzhi: zhabs kyu gnyis: ha 'dogs gnyis: la 'dogs gnyis: sde tshan brgyad: oṃ dang swā hā med do: u ma'i sngags rgod las myur: nā nā kha dhes zas nor spel: zhes pa ni: nor bsgrub na gong gi sngags kyi sham bur: nā nā kha dhe sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes 'bru sna la bsngags te: khang pa'i bang ba'am: mdzod phug tu zla ba yar ngo la skar ma bre 'ong dus gtor na: nor phyug por 'gyur ro: 'di rnams gter kha gzhan du gab bo: drod tshad zhal gdams la sogs zhal las shes: zhes pa ni: gal te cho 'phrul bslangs nas zhi ru ma 'dod na: sngags 'dis gzir: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm hā kro ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: du tri phu ti hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa: pad+mān+ta kṛta ha yaṃ grī wa ya ma ra tsa ra du hur thum dza: mā ra ya rbad nan: zhes bzlas pas rang zhir 'gro 'o: skabs su bstod cing 'dzab tu bzla: rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi las tshogs rdzogs so: ྈྈ ྈྈ 1$0000250byang zang zang lha brag gi nub zangs mdzod dmar po nas/ rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas bton pa'o//1$0000300 ༄༅: rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dbang chog bzhugs so: rta mgrin dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sngon 'gro bkra shis dag pa'i sa phyogs su: maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor mkho ba'i yo byad bsags: slob dpon bskyed rdzogs lta ba'i gding ldan pas: gsol btab bsnyen pa rang dbang lung nod bya: dngos gzhi slob ma khrus dbyung mig dar dang: me tog dang bcas phyi nas 'di skad zhu: kye: 'gro ba'i mgon po ston pa bla na med: bde gshegs kun 'dus bdag la dgongs su gsol: ma rig las kyis mnar ba'i sems can la: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang mchog bskur du gsol: bla mas: kye: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod bdag la gson: gsang ba mchog 'di rab tu gnyan pas na: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig bsrung nus sam: de ltar khas len bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin:

sa ma ya: i dan+to na ra kan: zhes bdud rtsi blud: de nas nang du bcug bgegs bskrad: srung 'khor bsgoms la gral du 'khod: kye ho: bla ma bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad kyis: byin rlabs ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol: de nas skyabs sems sngon song slob ma lha ru bskyed: hrī: lho nub dga' ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod nas: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dbang gi lha: bde gshegs khro bo'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: thugs rjes brtser dgongs gnas 'dir byin phob cig: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: zhes pas gnyis med bstim: puṣ+pe sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes me tog 'bul: puṣ+pe a bhi ṣiñcas dbang bskur sbyin: mig phye nang gi lha ngo sprad: de nas bum dbang bskur ba ni: hrī: rin chen bum pa mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs nang: dag byed ye shes bdud rtsi lha yi chu: bde gshegs dbang chen 'dus pa'i bum pa yis: skal ldan dbang bskur dbang bzhi'i snod gyur cig: hrīḥka lā sha kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: byin dbab bum dbang ngo sprod dag pa brjod: gsang dbang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ni: hrī: chos sku snang mtha'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: longs spyod rdzogs sku snang tshul cir yang ston: sprul sku khro rgyal rta mgrin dbang gi lha: kun 'dus byang sems bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ro: hrīḥbo dhi tsit+ta a mṛta wā ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gsal stong ngo sprod de bzhin dag pa brjod: me long sin+dhu ra yi dbang bskur ni: hrī: reg bya'i bde ba 'jam zhing yid du 'ong: stong gsal mnyam yangs ye shes gsal 'grib med: sna tshogs 'char ba shes rab dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan gsang sngags dam par dbang bskur ro: hrīḥkarma mu dra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bde stong ngo sprod de bzhin dag pa brjod: bzhi pa gtor dbang bskur zhing: hrī: snod bcud rnam dag rten dang brten par bcas: rang lus phung khams dang bcas gzhal yas khang:

don dam rig stong 'gyur med bzhi pa'i dbang: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: hrīḥti la ka dz+nyā na ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bzhi par ngo sprod de bzhin dag pa brjod: gzhan don nus la bka' srung gtad rgya byed: dam bsre rjes ni gtang rag tshogs 'khor shis pa brjod: de ltar dbang chen dregs pa'i dbang bskur thabs: rang gi mig dang snying las phangs gyur kyang: ma 'ongs snyigs ma bzhi bcu kha ral dus: dam sri sde brgyad rdul du brlag pa yi: chos zab pad+ma'i snying khrag dwangs ma 'di: 'gro ba mchog dman su yis nyams blangs kyang: phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar nges: rtag tu mi 'bral bcang ba'i chos mchog tu: bzang ngan 'brel tshad thugs rje'i smon lam gyis: bde chen gnas su 'khrid pas de la sprod: drag mo snying zan khyod la gtad do rgya: gter rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya:
